title: Random Oddities
description: A collection of my unclassified ideas.
body:
# Random Oddities This mod contains my unclassified ideas and will keep updating. **If you have any good ideas you can submit on GitHub.** ## Contents
### Tools & Redstones - Auto Crafter & Item Deleter: Crafting and deleting items in inventory. - Elytra Combine Smithing Template: Combine elytra with any chestplates. (Found in end cities.) - Placer & Breaker: Place and break blocks. - Enchant Separate Table: Separate last enchantment from item. ### Animals - Baby Capsule: Set animal to baby. - Stop Growing Capsule & Growing Capsule: Let animals stop growing or resume growing. ### Decoration - Plastic chair: A stackable and dyeable chair. (Do not put on head) ## Discord https://discord.gg/NDzz2upqAk
